name: Plasman - Lawrenceburg Manufacturing
old_description: Plasman’s exterior trim sector specializes in window assemblies and regulators, rack lifts, door frames, and roof rail systems.
about:
Plasman operates a manufacturing facility in Lawrenceburg, Tennessee, as part of a global automotive components company headquartered in Windsor, Canada, with a European headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. The business traces its roots back more than 45 years to a two-person tool shop and has grown into a multinational presence across nine countries including the United States, Canada, Mexico, Sweden, Norway, Belgium, the Czech Republic, Germany, and Japan. The Lawrenceburg site contributes to the company's network of manufacturing, engineering, and sales locations serving automotive OEMs worldwide.

The company produces a range of automotive exterior and structural components, including window assemblies and regulators, rack lifts, door frames, roof rail systems, bumpers and fascias, grilles, and subsystem modules. Its production capabilities span injection molding, chroming, paint application, and fully automated robotic assembly, supported by more than 200 engineers and technicians dedicated to molding and over 290,000 square feet of tooling capacity. Surface finishing technologies include Omniluxe®, a physical vapor deposition process positioned as an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional chrome plating, and Brilliance, a paint-over-chrome finish.

Plasman serves automotive original equipment manufacturers globally, delivering single-source solutions from concept through completion. Its customer base extends across North America, Europe, and Asia, with the company emphasizing collaborative partnerships and the ability to manage complex, high-volume programs for major vehicle platforms.

The organization highlights its collaborative mindset and single-source model as key differentiators, aiming to provide design, tooling, molding, finishing, and assembly under one roof. The development of proprietary finishes such as Omniluxe® reflects a stated focus on meeting evolving environmental regulations and OEM demands for sustainable surface solutions.

name: Plastech Machining & Fab Inc.
old_description: Robotics capabilities helping with our rapid growth in plastics machining.
about:
Plastech Machining & Fab Inc. operates from Bow, New Hampshire. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It specializes in precision plastics machining and fabrication, serving customers with engineering-grade materials.

The shop runs 3-axis and 5-axis CNC machining centers, including Hurco VM20i and VMX30Ui models, Robodrill mills with pallet changers, and a 48-by-96-inch Multicam router. Robotics and automation support high-volume work. A Brown & Sharpe Micro-Hite CMM handles first-piece inspection and process control. The company produces prototypes and production runs of components machined from Ultem, Delrin, ABS, acetal, and other engineering plastics.

Plastech serves customers needing tight-tolerance plastic parts for complex applications, though specific industry sectors are not listed on its site. It also offers a path to injection molding through its sister company, PlasTech Molding Solutions, which has over 70 years of molding experience.

The company emphasizes a "machine to mold" strategy, letting clients start with low-volume machining and shift to custom molding as demand grows. Its quality system is registered to ISO 9001:2015 through TÜV SÜD America, and it highlights on-time delivery and automated inspection for consistent precision.

name: Plastic BagMart
about:
Plastic BagMart operates from Eden Prairie, Minnesota, where it has been family-owned and family-operated for more than three decades. The business began with plastic bags 30 years ago and has since expanded its product lines while remaining under family stewardship.

The company stocks and distributes a broad range of packaging and janitorial supplies, including plastic bags, paper bags, retail packaging, paper products, and credit-card, POS, and cash-register paper. Orders are shipped from its warehouse within 48 hours as a standard service, with rush options available. Plastic BagMart ships any quantity—even less than full cases—via its own local delivery trucks in the surrounding area and by FedEx or common carrier nationwide.

Its customer base spans individual consumers and small to mid-size businesses such as retailers, warehouses, and offices. The assortment is tailored to those segments, and the company emphasizes friendly, personal service regardless of order size.

Founded on a goal of customer satisfaction, Plastic BagMart differentiates itself with a no-minimum-order policy, quantity discounts, a 30-day return window, and the ability to source custom-printed items not listed in its catalog.

name: Plastic Injection Molding | Advance Plastics
old_description: Custom plastic injection molder based in San Diego County, California.
about:
Based in National City, California, Advance Plastics has built nearly 40 years of experience in custom plastic injection molding. The company operates its main plant in San Diego County, producing parts that carry the “Made in the USA” designation.

Advance Plastics provides custom injection molding services using machines ranging from 35 to 1,000 tons of clamping force. The facility includes an on-site tool room and offers a lifetime guarantee on molds sourced from its supplier IMS. Production volumes span low, medium, and high quantities, with a focus on high-quality products and on-time delivery.

The company serves customers requiring aerospace-quality standards, holding AS9100D certification. It also produces NSF-compliant parts for food and water applications and manufactures components that meet CFR regulatory requirements. These capabilities position it for regulated industries such as aerospace, medical, and food equipment.

Advance Plastics differentiates itself through its on-site tool room, lifetime mold guarantee, and AS9100D-certified quality system. The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing and a commitment to quality and delivery performance.

name: Plastic Injection Molding | Norco Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Southern California's Premier Injection Molding Company | Large Tonnage Specialists Since 1974
about:
Norco Plastics, Inc. operates from an 88,000-square-foot facility in Chino, California. The company was founded in 1974 by the Williams family in nearby Norco, California, starting with just two machines. Today, the second generation of the Williams family continues to own and manage the business, maintaining its roots as a family-owned manufacturer.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding with a clamping force range of 30 to 2,800 tons across 25 presses. Its capabilities include insert molding, multi-material molding, and a suite of secondary operations such as hot stamping, robotic part removal, assembly, and surface finishing. The facility runs 24/7 and employs approximately 60 people, offering end-to-end services that extend to mold maintenance, supply chain management, inventory control, and logistics distribution throughout Southern California.

Norco Plastics serves a diverse set of industries, including construction (weather-resistant barriers and structural supports), storage and logistics (impact-resistant totes and stackable containers), consumer products (food-grade, BPA-free housewares), agriculture (irrigation components), automotive (tight-tolerance components), and medical (non-invasive devices with cleanroom-capable production). Its customer base spans Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, and San Diego counties.

The company differentiates itself through its large-tonnage capacity—highlighted by the 2023 installation of a 2,800-ton press—round-the-clock production, and ISO 9001:2015-compliant quality systems with coordinate measuring machine capability to ±0.0001 inch. Its five-decade history and continued investment in equipment position it as a single-source partner for both precision components and large-scale molded parts.

name: Plastics Processing Corporation
old_description: At Plastic Processing , we feature a high tech production facility that is flexible and quickly adaptable to meet your specific needs. Our manufacturing capabilities span a broad range of products and industries.
about:
Plastics Processing Corporation, doing business as Plastic Processing, operates from Gardena, California. The company, also known as Narayan Corporation DBA Plastic Processing, has over 20 years of experience in blow molding and emphasizes a flexible, high-tech production facility that adapts quickly to customer needs.

The shop produces plastic bottles, containers, and jars using blow molding across three primary resins: PET, HDPE, and PVC. It builds molds in-house and runs customer-owned tooling, with a noted Beckum machine among its equipment. The company handles custom bottle design for industrial, cosmetic, and cleaning-supply applications, and fulfills orders from custom runs to stock items, shipped by bulk, pallet, or single case.

Customers span industrial, cosmetic, and cleaning-supply sectors, though the company states it serves any industry needing plastic containers.

The company emphasizes its ability to mold all three major container types, its Southern California location for quick turnaround, and a track record of on-time delivery that often beats schedule. It also highlights volume efficiency and speed as levers to meet target pricing.

name: Plastics Unlimited
old_description: "A leader in custom thermoforming, composites, & urethane processes with innovations that deliver excellent quality on-time."
about:
Plastics Unlimited operates from a 130,000-square-foot facility in Preston, Iowa. The company was founded in 1993 by Terry, Nancy, and Gene Kieffer on their family farm after the physical toll of livestock farming prompted them to seek a less labor-intensive venture. They purchased a used thermoforming machine at auction, installed it in a machine shed, and began producing dunnage for local agricultural customers.

Today the manufacturer provides custom thermoforming (both heavy- and thin-gauge), composites — including its proprietary Tooless Engineered Composites (TEC)® process — and urethane molding. In-house design and tooling teams work alongside CNC robotic trimming and secondary assembly operations. The facility has grown from a 15,000-square-foot industrial park building acquired in 1997 to its current footprint, supporting high-volume production for a range of industries.

The company serves agriculture, construction, dunnage, material handling, medical, OEM, outdoor/recreation, aerospace, industrial, and transportation markets. Its customer base includes agricultural machinery manufacturers, medical device OEMs, and construction equipment builders who value large-part capability and moderate volumes that align with thermoforming economics.

The founders' farming heritage informs the company's stated differentiators: planet stewardship, quality products, innovative technology, a can-do attitude, and outstanding customer service. Plastics Unlimited emphasizes its award-winning status, green innovation initiatives, and a quality system documented in writing, positioning itself as a supplier that combines agricultural pragmatism with advanced plastics engineering.
